gloss: staff member of a station or bureau (especially police)

definitions.explanation: A person employed at an official station or bureau. Most commonly refers to staff at a police station, fire station, or similar government office.

examples.japanese: {署員|しょいん}が{現場|げんば}に{向|む}かった。
examples.english: Station staff headed to the scene.

examples.japanese: {消防署|しょうぼうしょ}の{署員|しょいん}が{訓練|くんれん}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: Staff from the fire station conducted a training exercise.

examples.japanese: {警察署|けいさつしょ}の{署員|しょいん}{全員|ぜんいん}が{集|あつ}まって、{事件|じけん}の{捜査方針|そうさほうしん}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: All staff at the police station gathered to confirm the investigation plan for the case.

notes:
Refers to employees or staff members of a {署|しょ} (station/bureau). Most commonly encountered in the context of police ({警察署|けいさつしょ}) or fire departments ({消防署|しょうぼうしょ}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {警察|けいさつ}{署員|しょいん} (police station staff)
- {消防|しょうぼう}{署員|しょいん} (fire station staff)
- {署員|しょいん}が{駆|か}けつける (staff rush to the scene)

Frequently appears in news reports about emergency response and law enforcement.
